create or replace function public.s6_submit_private_choice(p_room_code text,p_session_token text,p_client_request_id uuid,p_choice_id text)returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$declare room text:=upper(trim(p_room_code));p public.s1_room_players%rowtype;g public.game_runs%rowtype;s public.s6_run_state%rowtype;n int;role text;begin p:=public.s1_get_player_by_session(room,p_session_token);g:=public.s2_get_active_run(room);select*into s from public.s6_run_state where run_id=g.run_id for update;role:=(select role_key from public.s6_allocations where run_id=g.run_id and player_id=p.player_id);if s.phase_key not in('act10_private','act12_pressure')then raise exception'No private Sprint 6 choice is open.';end if;if s.phase_key='act10_private'and p_choice_id not in('take','leave')then raise exception'Invalid ACT 10 private choice.';end if;if s.phase_key='act12_pressure'and((role=s.mechanism_failure_station and p_choice_id not in('one','two','three','four'))or(role<>s.mechanism_failure_station and p_choice_id not in('hold','encourage','watch','prepare')))then raise exception'Invalid pressure choice for role context.';end if;
 insert into public.s6_choices values(g.run_id,s.phase_key,s.round_no,p.player_id,p_choice_id,p_client_request_id,round(extract(epoch from(now()-s.updated_at))*1000)::int,role,now())on conflict(run_id,player_id,client_request_id)do nothing;select count(*)into n from public.s6_choices where run_id=g.run_id and phase_key=s.phase_key and round_no=s.round_no;if n=3 and s.phase_key='act10_private'then update public.s6_run_state set phase_key='act10_final_vote',round_no=1,updated_at=now()where run_id=g.run_id;elsif n=3 then update public.s6_run_state set phase_key='act12_cinematic',failure_resolution='cinematic_auto_resolution',mechanism_failure_active=false,escape_success=true,act_no=13,updated_at=now()where run_id=g.run_id;perform public.s6_set_scene(g.run_id,'act13_escape','act13_boundary','escape_success','CINEMATIC_MESSAGE','act13.001');end if;return jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'submitted',n);end$$;

create or replace function public.s6_submit_allocation(p_room_code text,p_session_token text,p_client_request_id uuid,p_role_key text)returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$declare room text:=upper(trim(p_room_code));p public.s1_room_players%rowtype;g public.game_runs%rowtype;s public.s6_run_state%rowtype;n int;distinct_n int;c_owner text;valid boolean;prior public.s6_allocations%rowtype;begin p:=public.s1_get_player_by_session(room,p_session_token);g:=public.s2_get_active_run(room);select*into s from public.s6_run_state where run_id=g.run_id for update;if s.phase_key<>'act11_allocation'then raise exception'Allocation is not open.';end if;if(s.gold_key and p_role_key not in('A','B','WATCHER'))or(not s.gold_key and p_role_key not in('A','B','C'))then raise exception'Invalid role for Golden Key branch.';end if;select*into prior from public.s6_allocations where run_id=g.run_id and player_id=p.player_id and client_request_id=p_client_request_id;if found then if prior.role_key<>p_role_key then raise exception'Request identity reused with different content.';end if;return jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'idempotent_replay',true);end if;
 insert into public.s6_allocations values(g.run_id,p.player_id,p_role_key,p_client_request_id,now())on conflict(run_id,player_id)do update set role_key=excluded.role_key,client_request_id=excluded.client_request_id,locked_at=now();select count(*),count(distinct role_key)into n,distinct_n from public.s6_allocations where run_id=g.run_id;if n<3 then return jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'submitted',n);end if;select rp.role_slot into c_owner from public.s6_allocations a join public.s1_room_players rp using(player_id)where a.run_id=g.run_id and a.role_key='C';valid:=distinct_n=3 and((s.gold_key and not exists(select 1 from public.s6_allocations where run_id=g.run_id and role_key not in('A','B','WATCHER')))or(not s.gold_key and not exists(select 1 from public.s6_allocations where run_id=g.run_id and role_key not in('A','B','C'))and c_owner='GAL-C'));if not valid then delete from public.s6_allocations where run_id=g.run_id;update public.s6_run_state set round_no=round_no+1,updated_at=now()where run_id=g.run_id;perform public.s2_log_event(g.run_id,room,null,'escape_penalty_event',null,jsonb_build_object('penalty_key','allocation_rework','behavior_scoring',false));return jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'allocation_valid',false,'wrong_c_owner',c_owner is not null and c_owner<>'GAL-C');end if;update public.s6_run_state set allocation_valid=true,act_no=12,phase_key='act12_engage',round_no=1,updated_at=now()where run_id=g.run_id;perform public.s6_set_scene(g.run_id,'act12_main_gate','act12_engage','waiting','ACTION_SCREEN','act11.001');return jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'allocation_valid',true);end$$;

latest_defined_function_source.name: s6_engage
latest_defined_function_source.source_exact_sql_definition: create or replace function public.s6_engage(p_room_code text,p_session_token text,p_role_key text)returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$declare room text:=upper(trim(p_room_code));p public.s1_room_players%rowtype;g public.game_runs%rowtype;s public.s6_run_state%rowtype;n int;failure text;begin p:=public.s1_get_player_by_session(room,p_session_token);g:=public.s2_get_active_run(room);select*into s from public.s6_run_state where run_id=g.run_id for update;if s.phase_key<>'act12_tasks'or not exists(select 1 from public.s6_allocations where run_id=g.run_id and player_id=p.player_id and role_key=p_role_key)or not exists(select 1 from public.s6_station_tasks where run_id=g.run_id and player_id=p.player_id and role_key=p_role_key)then raise exception'Role task must be completed before ENGAGE.';end if;insert into public.s6_engagements values(g.run_id,p_role_key,p.player_id,now())on conflict do nothing;select count(*)into n from public.s6_engagements where run_id=g.run_id;if n=3 then select role_key into failure from public.s6_allocations where run_id=g.run_id and role_key in('A','B','C')order by md5(g.run_id::text||role_key)limit 1;update public.s6_run_state set phase_key='act12_pressure',mechanism_failure_active=true,mechanism_failure_station=failure,failure_resolution='pending',round_no=1,feedback_text_keys=array[case failure when'A'then'act12.005'when'B'then'act12.006'else'act12.007'end],updated_at=now()where run_id=g.run_id;end if;return jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'engaged',n,'failure_started',n=3,'failure_station',case when n=3 then failure end);end$$;

latest_defined_function_source.source_exact_sql_definition: create function public.s6_send_message_guarded(p_room_code text,p_session_token text,p_expected_discussion_session_id uuid,p_client_request_id uuid,p_message_text text)returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$declare room text:=upper(trim(p_room_code));p public.s1_room_players%rowtype;g public.game_runs%rowtype;d public.discussion_sessions%rowtype;t text:=trim(coalesce(p_message_text,''));prior public.s6_action_receipts%rowtype;mid bigint;begin p:=public.s1_get_player_by_session(room,p_session_token);g:=public.s2_get_active_run(room);select*into prior from public.s6_action_receipts where run_id=g.run_id and player_id=p.player_id and request_id=p_client_request_id;if found then if prior.action_key<>'message'or prior.payload<>jsonb_build_object('session',p_expected_discussion_session_id,'text',t)then raise exception'Request identity reused with different content.';end if;return prior.result||jsonb_build_object('idempotent_replay',true);end if;select*into d from public.discussion_sessions where discussion_session_id=p_expected_discussion_session_id and run_id=g.run_id for update;if not found or d.status<>'discussion'or d.phase_deadline<=now()then raise exception'Stale or closed Sprint 6 discussion.';end if;if t=''or char_length(t)>1000 then raise exception'Message must contain 1-1000 characters.';end if;insert into public.dialogue_messages(run_id,discussion_session_id,scene_id,phase_key,step_key,player_id,message_text)values(g.run_id,d.discussion_session_id,d.scene_id,d.phase_key,d.step_key,p.player_id,t)returning message_id into mid;insert into public.s6_action_receipts values(g.run_id,p.player_id,p_client_request_id,'message',jsonb_build_object('session',p_expected_discussion_session_id,'text',t),jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'message_id',mid),now());return jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'message_id',mid);end$$;

latest_defined_function_source.source_exact_sql_definition: create function public.s6_close_discussion_guarded(p_room_code text,p_session_token text,p_expected_phase text,p_expected_step int,p_expected_round int,p_expected_discussion_session_id uuid)returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$declare room text:=upper(trim(p_room_code));p public.s1_room_players%rowtype;g public.game_runs%rowtype;s public.s6_run_state%rowtype;d public.discussion_sessions%rowtype;nextphase text;begin p:=public.s1_get_player_by_session(room,p_session_token);g:=public.s2_get_active_run(room);select*into s from public.s6_run_state where run_id=g.run_id for update;perform public.s6_assert_identity(s,p_expected_phase,p_expected_step,p_expected_round);select*into d from public.discussion_sessions where discussion_session_id=p_expected_discussion_session_id and run_id=g.run_id for update;if not found or d.status<>'discussion'or d.phase_key<>p_expected_phase then raise exception'Stale Sprint 6 discussion identity.';end if;if d.phase_deadline>now()and(select run_mode from public.game_runs where run_id=g.run_id)<>'audit'then raise exception'Discussion timer is still active.';end if;update public.discussion_sessions set status='resolved',ended_at=now(),phase_deadline=null,outcome=jsonb_build_object('type','discussion_complete')where discussion_session_id=d.discussion_session_id;nextphase:=case p_expected_phase when'act9_discussion'then'act9_console'when'act10_discussion'then'act10_final_vote'when'act11_discussion'then'act11_allocation'else null end;if nextphase is null then raise exception'Invalid Sprint 6 discussion transition.';end if;update public.s6_run_state set phase_key=nextphase,feedback_text_keys='{}',feedback_audio_key=null,updated_at=now()where run_id=g.run_id;return jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'phase_key',nextphase);end$$;
